decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1	The proposal would result in the loss of usable employment space, for which adequate justification has not been provided.  It is therefore contrary to H.3.5 and E.1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan (Adopted 12th December 2003).

2.	The layout, density and inadequate amenity space would result in an over development of the site and an unacceptable residential environment for potential occupiers contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.3.5, H.4.1 and H.4.2 of the Unitary Development Plan (Adopted 12th December 2003) and Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).   

3.	There would be insufficient adequately sized and located car parking space and it would thereby be contrary to Policies H.4.1 and T.1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan (Adopted 12th December 2003)
	
4.	The proposal would not make adequate provision for refuse collection or for access by emergency vehicles to the rear contrary to Policy H.4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan (Adopted 12th December 2003).

5.	The proposal would result in an over-development on the site, out of character with the surrounding dwellinghouses and would be detrimental to the streetscene, and contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1 of the Revised Deposit Version Unitary Development Plan (Adopted 12th December 2003).

6	The proposed vehicle crossover without a visibility splay would have a negative effect on traffic and pedestrian safety and therefore is contrary to policies ENV B.1.1, H.4.1 and T.2.1 of the Revised Deposit Version Unitary Development Plan (Adopted 12th December 2003).
description: Demolition of existing buildings and the erection of 9 x self contained units.
